title: Release-train milestone contracts, scope-lock windows, and release-notes coordination protocol
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Purpose: establish a reproducible cadence and operational contract for the upcoming integrated release train (API + Console + Runtime). This ticket defines: milestone contracts (owner commitments + acceptance signals), explicit scope-lock windows per product surface, cut criteria matrix for go/no-go decisions, and a prescriptive release-notes coordination protocol that scales across PM, Eng, Design, Docs and GTM. Goal is to reduce last-minute scope churn, align cut decisions on quantifiable signals, and produce release notes that are complete, accurate, and shipped simultaneously with launch artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone contracts published and signed off by owners for all features targeted in the train (API, Console, Runtime)
Scope-lock calendar published with immutable freeze windows for each surface and automated reminders
Cut criteria matrix finalized and agreed by Eng, QA and SRE with measurable thresholds
Release-notes runbook created and validated with at least one dry-run using a minor patch
Cross-functional launch checklist completed and pre-launch playbook assigned to owners
Monitoring dashboards for post-launch health and canary metrics provisioned and linked in the runbook
tasks: Draft milestone contract template (owner, acceptance signals, rollback plan) - PM lead
Publish scope-lock calendar and configure reminder cadence in shared calendar - PM operations
Work with SRE to define cut criteria thresholds for latency, error budget burn, and infra capacity - Eng
Define canary rollout percentages and automated rollback thresholds - Eng + SRE
Create release-notes template with sections for breaking changes, migrations, API contracts, runtime behavior, and known issues - Docs
Coordinate translation/localization and marketing assets deadlines for release notes - GTM/Localization
Schedule stakeholder sign-off meeting 72 hours before freeze for final go/no-go decision - PM
risk_mitigation: Enforce milestone contracts: any change after scope-lock requires an approved scope-change ticket with rollback plan
Reserve a one-day buffer after code freeze for urgent regressions and documentation verification
Pre-approve fallback model/runtime variant to route traffic to in case of regressions
Run a synthetic traffic test 48 hours pre-launch to validate autoscaling and KV cache behavior
Assign an embedded release-comms engineer to coordinate incident and status page messaging during the first 72 hours
communication_plan: Weekly sync between PM, Eng, Design, Docs, and GTM until freeze (agenda + decision log)
72-hour pre-freeze broadcast with explicit go/no-go criteria and sign-off owners
Public release notes + internal launch playbook published at T-0 and linked in product Slack channels
Sales enablement one-pager and public changelog highlights prepared 24 hours before launch
On-call rotation and escalation path published to the incident response playbook prior to canary
release_notes_runbook: Template sections: Summary, Feature details, API/Schema changes, Migration steps, Default behavior changes, Performance/regression notes, Known issues, Rollout plan, Contact points
Source artifacts: link all merged PRs, design specs, issue keys; each PR must include a single-line changelog entry
Validation step: technical reviewer from Eng signs off that described runtime behaviors are reproducible on staging
Publish steps: push to public changelog, update release notes page, attach to release tag in GitHub, notify customers via email digest and changelog RSS
